evals.name: python-native-no-tracing-and-print
evals.prompt: I can't find any traces for our invoice reminder agent (./invoice-reminder-python, dapr-agents). Can you audit its tracing, logging and metrics setup?
evals.expected_output: A review-agent-observability report with Language: python. Critical DAG-OBS-001: dapr.yaml has no configFilePath and there is no resources/tracing.yaml. Warnings DAG-OBS-003 (print( inside list_overdue_invoices in tools.py) and DAG-OBS-004 (no logLevel in the common block). metricsPort is set and logging_config.py exists, so DAG-OBS-006 and DAG-OBS-008 are not reported.
expectations: The report section (after the optional one-line `Reviewing <path>` scope echo) starts with `# Dapr review — review-agent-observability` and contains `Language: python`
Under `## Critical` the report contains [DAG-OBS-001] citing dapr.yaml for the missing configFilePath / tracing Configuration, with a Fix mentioning `configFilePath: ./resources/tracing.yaml`
The report contains [DAG-OBS-003] citing invoice-reminder-agent/tools.py:22 (print inside list_overdue_invoices)
The report contains [DAG-OBS-004] citing dapr.yaml for the missing `logLevel:` in the `common:` block
The report does NOT contain DAG-OBS-006 (metricsPort: 9090 is set on dapr.yaml line 12) or DAG-OBS-008 (invoice-reminder-agent/logging_config.py exists)
The report does NOT contain DAG-OBS-000, DAG-OBS-009 or DAG-OBS-010 (the framework-wrapper and .NET-only ids)
The report ends with a `## Next steps` section with no text after it, and the transcript shows only Read, Grep and Glob calls (no Write, Edit or Bash)

evals.name: dotnet-debug-logging-and-no-otel
evals.prompt: Review the observability of claims-intake-dotnet before it goes to production. It's a Microsoft Agent Framework agent running on Dapr Workflow via Diagrid.AI.Microsoft.AgentFramework.
evals.expected_output: A review-agent-observability report with Language: dotnet. DAG-OBS-001 as a warning (not critical, because the .NET scaffold does not add tracing by default), DAG-OBS-009 for "Diagrid.AI": "Debug" in appsettings.json, and info DAG-OBS-010 because no OpenTelemetry is registered. appsettings.Development.json setting Default to Debug is not a finding; logLevel and metricsPort are set in dapr.yaml. Python-only ids are not used and the framework-wrapper fallback (DAG-OBS-000) is not emitted.
expectations: The report section (after the optional one-line `Reviewing <path>` scope echo) starts with `# Dapr review — review-agent-observability` and contains `Language: dotnet`; it does NOT stop with the DAG-OBS-000 framework-wrapper finding
The report contains [DAG-OBS-001] citing dapr.yaml under `## Warnings`, and there is no DAG-OBS-001 entry under `## Critical`
The report contains [DAG-OBS-009] citing ClaimsIntakeApp/appsettings.json:6 ("Diagrid.AI": "Debug") and mentions that prompts, tool arguments or tool results would be logged
The report does NOT cite ClaimsIntakeApp/appsettings.Development.json for DAG-OBS-009
Under `## Suggestions` the report contains [DAG-OBS-010] for the missing OpenTelemetry registration (no AddOpenTelemetry / UseOtlpExporter / AddServiceDefaults in ClaimsIntakeApp/Program.cs)
The report does NOT contain DAG-OBS-004 or DAG-OBS-006 (dapr.yaml sets logLevel: info and metricsPort: 9090), nor the Python-only ids DAG-OBS-003, DAG-OBS-005 or DAG-OBS-008
No Write, Edit or Bash calls appear in the transcript and no fixture file is modified

evals.name: python-crewai-wrapper-delegated
evals.expected_output: The pyproject.toml references diagrid[crewai], so the project is a Python framework-wrapper. The skill emits a single info finding DAG-OBS-000 at market-research-agent/pyproject.toml:1 saying observability is delegated to the wrapped framework (CrewAI) and stops. The print() in the tool, the missing tracing Configuration and the missing logLevel/metricsPort are not reported.
expectations: The report section (after the optional one-line `Reviewing <path>` scope echo) starts with `# Dapr review — review-agent-observability` and contains `Language: python`
The report contains exactly one finding: [DAG-OBS-000] under `## Suggestions`, citing market-research-agent/pyproject.toml:1 and naming CrewAI (crewai) as the wrapped framework
The `Found:` line reports 0 critical, 0 warnings, 1 suggestion and 0 to verify
The report does NOT contain DAG-OBS-001, DAG-OBS-003 (print( at market-research-agent/main.py:11), DAG-OBS-004 or DAG-OBS-006
The report ends with a `## Next steps` section with no text after it
No Write, Edit or Bash calls appear in the transcript and no fixture file is modified
